title: Console release notes cadence, enablement calendar, and cross-team runsheet for dashboards & rollouts
creator: Aisha Banerjee
description:
Summary: Coordinate the release notes cadence, internal enablement calendar, and cross-team runsheet for the upcoming Console dashboards + rollout controls feature set. The goal is to ensure consistent messaging across Docs, Support, Sales, and Solutions, schedule training sessions for customer-facing teams, and publish a coordinated release notes bundle that maps features to impact and migration steps.

Scope: release notes content plan (user-facing and admin-facing), a three-week enablement calendar with recorded + live sessions, a cross-team runbook for launch day (including rollback criteria and monitoring owners), and a set of one-pagers for Sales and CS. This ticket covers planning and authoring coordination; separate tickets will track translation, infra rollout gating, and code docs sync.

Why now: Console dashboards and rollout control surfaces are entering final QA. We need a repeatable cadence and clear handoffs so enterprise customers have SSO and audit mapping ready at GA, and support can handle initial inquiries without escalations.
acceptance_criteria: Release notes draft (user + admin sections) pinned in Confluence and approved by PM and Docs
Enablement calendar published and invites scheduled for Sales, CS, Solutions, and Support
Runbook with alerting/SLR owners and rollback criteria reviewed by Eng Reliability and SRE
Sales one-pager and CS troubleshooting cheat sheet created and uploaded to Drive
At least two recorded training sessions available and one live Q&A scheduled before GA
deliverables: Launch runbook with step-by-step play for cutover and rollback
Sales one-pager and CS triage checklist
Post-launch monitoring dashboard template and error escalation matrix
communication_schedule: T-14 days: internal TL;DR + feature matrix posted to #console-launch
T-10 days: release notes first draft shared with Docs and Legal
T-7 days: enablement calendar invites sent; Sales one-pager first review
T-3 days: runbook dry-run with Eng + SRE + Support
Launch day: pre-launch status ping at 08:00 PT and post-launch summary at 18:00 PT
D+2 days: early adoption health check and top-10 customer questions roundup
pre_launch_checklist: Finalize release notes and get sign-off from Docs and Legal
Publish feature flags and verify canary rollout path
Confirm SSO audit logs mapping for enterprise customers
Record and upload training videos to Drive
Schedule live Q&A for Sales and CS
Ensure monitoring dashboards contain new metrics and alert thresholds
Prepare template responses for common support inquiries
post_launch_monitoring: 24/7 watch window for first 72 hours with a designated on-call rotation
Dashboard: latency p95, error rate per route, rollout percentage by org
Ticket triage SLA: first response < 2 hours for P1 customer incidents
Weekly adoption report for first month and regression alerts tied to eval sets
